note: Per-role model configuration for the post-reproduction experiments (exp_core/models.py). Roles: rulebuild (every rule-building LLM call), guard (every guard LLM call: structured calls and the planner tool loop), agent (τ-bench tool-calling agent), user (τ-bench user simulator). Each role names a deployment on the existing Azure AI Foundry resource (utility/utils.py endpoint, Managed Identity). 'api' (agent/user only): 'responses' or 'chat'. 'effort': reasoning effort for agent/user; guard and rule-building efforts stay as configured in their own code (ShieldConfig, DirectGuard, repro_core/config.json). Phase-0 probes: output/tgr/p0/; decisions: docs/tgr/p0_report.md.

nano-agent-luna.note: weak agent + strong guard experiment (2026-10-20): agent = gpt-5-nano with P6's settings (chat completions, deployment default reasoning effort, no temperature); user simulator, guards and rule building = gpt-6-luna

pricing.note: USD per 1M tokens, Azure Retail Prices API (prices.azure.com), region swedencentral, deployment SKU GlobalStandard (read from ARM 2026-10-19), short-context meters. Reasoning tokens bill as output. Cost metrics use list input price without the cached-input discount (as P6); cached tokens are recorded separately.

gpt-6-luna.meters: 6-luna ShortCo Inp/Cd Inp/Opt Std Gl; long context (LongCo): 0.20/0.02/0.75
